podcast.title: Direct Gabber Lineage
podcast.body: Speedcore is explicitly identified as one of the genres, alongside Frenchcore and Uptempo Hardcore, that directly descends from the Gabber lineage. It carries forward the tradition of extreme speed and intensity in electronic music. "Junto al hardcore, el hardcore, el speedcore, el frenchcore. Hasta generos actuales, como el app Tempo hardcore, vehement directamente de este lineaje."

podcast.title: Harder Genre Influence in Hardvapour
podcast.body: Speedcore is one of the "harder genres" whose elements are incorporated into Hardvapour, contributing to its aggressive and dark sound, alongside techno, EDM, and Gabber. "generos más duros como El Speedcore y el Gaber"
